finalText:
Perfect! All tests are now passing. The issue was an off-by-one error in the `paginate` function. Since pages are 1-indexed (page 1 is the first page), the start position needed to be `(page - 1) * perPage` instead of `page * perPage`. This ensures:

- Page 1 starts at index 0 → items [1, 2, 3] ✓
- Page 2 starts at index 3 → items [4, 5, 6] ✓  
- Page 4 starts at index 9 → items [10] ✓

All 5 tests are passing now.
